name: rizamo
description: Publish, schedule and analyze social posts on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and more.

interface.longDescription:
Run your social accounts from ChatGPT.

Publish now or schedule reels, carousels, stories, videos and feed posts. Rizamo checks each network's media and text rules before a post goes out, and each profile has its own queue of posting times.

See how it went: views, reach, engagement and followers for any period against the one before, every post ranked, and who your audience is.

Answer people: read open comments and messages in one list, reply, hide or delete comments, and send a private message to people who comment a keyword.

Works with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube and more, with every brand you manage grouped in profiles. It needs a Rizamo account with at least one social account connected in Rizamo's web app, where you also add more. Rizamo does not generate images, video or audio.

You stay in charge. ChatGPT shows you what it will do before it publishes, replies or deletes. You choose which profiles it can reach when you connect, and you can remove its access at any time.
defaultPrompt: How did my posts do this month compared with last month?
Show me the open comments and messages that need a reply.
What is scheduled on my social accounts this week?

positive.prompt: Which social accounts do I have connected in Rizamo?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the connected accounts with network, handle and status. The test team has one TikTok account.

positive.prompt: What are my posting times in Rizamo, and what is in the queue?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the profile's posting times and any queued posts, in the profile's time zone.

positive.description: Compare a period with the one before
positive.prompt: How did my posts do in the last 30 days compared with the 30 days before?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports views, reach, engagements and followers against the previous period, without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: Create a draft TikTok post on my connected account with the attached video and the caption Trying Rizamo. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the attached video, asks for the TikTok choices that get_tiktok_creator_info lists, saves a draft, and says it has not been published.

positive.prompt: Show me the open comments and messages that need a reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the open threads, or says there are none. Sends no reply.

negative.prompt: Use Rizamo to generate a video of a cat for TikTok.

negative.description: A network with no connected account: says to connect it in Rizamo's web app
negative.prompt: Publish this text on my Instagram right now: Hello from Rizamo.

negative.description: A destructive request with no confirmation
negative.prompt: Delete every post on all my social accounts.

review.commerce_description: Rizamo does not sell products or take payments in ChatGPT. Plans are managed on rizamo.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: publish and schedule social posts from attached files, read analytics, and answer comments and messages.
